projects.title: Replay Platformer
projects.tagline: A 3D platformer with tight movement mechanics and accessibility options.
projects.description:
A 3D platformer featuring tight movement mechanics and accessibility options. Playable with both controller and keyboard, including a web version for easy access.

I thoroughly enjoyed developing this game, focusing heavily on game feel and visual polish to ensure the movement felt satisfying and responsive. Implementing the wall jump mechanics presented an interesting challenge, but it was rewarding to perfect.

This project sparked my passion for creating advanced movement systems, and I look forward to exploring more complex mechanics in future projects.

mechanics.subtitle: Wall Jump - Detection
mechanics.description: Continuous raycasting detects nearby walls, allowing the player to enter a 'Wall Slide' state. This state reduces terminal velocity and enables the wall jump mechanic.

mechanics.subtitle: Wall Jump - Execution
mechanics.description: Executing a jump while sliding applies an instantaneous impulse force away from the wall and upwards. A brief 'jump lock' prevents immediate redirection, ensuring a consistent arc.

mechanics.subtitle: Enemy State Machine
mechanics.description: A robust Finite State Machine (FSM) manages complex enemy behaviors, including Roaming, Chasing, and Attacking. This architecture allows for clean transitions and modular AI logic.

mechanics.subtitle: Heatmap-Based Roaming
mechanics.description: To create more natural exploration, enemies use a 'visit count' heatmap. They periodically sample nearby points and prioritize those they haven't visited recently, ensuring thorough coverage of the environment.

mechanics.subtitle: Enemy Combat Logic
mechanics.description: Enemies smoothly rotate to face the player before initiating attacks. The logic includes distance checks and cooldowns to maintain a balanced but challenging combat experience.

projects.title: Neon VR Store
projects.tagline: A virtual shopping experience with modular systems.
projects.description: A virtual reality simulation focused on retail and systems design. I built a modular shopping system that handles product scanning and card-based payments. This project allowed me to dive deep into ScriptableObjects and data-driven design, ensuring that adding new products or modifying prices is a seamless process for the developers.

mechanics.subtitle: Product Data & ScriptableObjects
mechanics.description: To manage the variety of items in the store, I used ScriptableObjects for Product Data. This allows for a modular system where each product's name and price are defined as data assets, making it easy to add new items without changing code.

mechanics.subtitle: Virtual Payment (Pinpas) System
mechanics.description: I built a virtual payment mechanic where players use a 'Pinpas' with a stored saldo. The Kassa Manager calculates the total from scanned ProductData assets and subtracts it from the card's balance after a successful transaction.

projects.title: Zombie Survival VR
projects.tagline: Survive the undead waves with precision and strategy.
projects.description:
A survival-focused VR combat experience where players must hold their ground against endless waves of zombies. I architected a complex AI system using custom State Machines to manage zombie behavior, and a Coroutine-based wave spawner to handle increasing difficulty curves.

The project emphasizes satisfying combat mechanics, specifically a precision-based shooting system that rewards headshots, requiring players to stay calm and aim carefully under pressure.

mechanics.subtitle: Zombie State Machine
mechanics.description: The undead enemies use a custom State Machine to manage their autonomous behavior. This includes a Coroutine-based roaming routine that picks random NavMesh positions, switching to high-speed 'Chase' states when the player is detected.

mechanics.subtitle: Wave Spawning System
mechanics.description: To keep the pressure on, I implemented a wave-based spawning system using Coroutines. Each wave increases the zombie count, and the system handles the cleanup and wave-clear logic via delegates when a zombie is destroyed.

mechanics.subtitle: Precision Headshot System
mechanics.description: The gun mechanics are designed to reward precision. Using Raycasts and tag detection, the system identifies if a shot hits the 'Head' tag for an instant kill, or hits another body part for no damage, encouraging players to aim carefully in VR.
